description: This dataset contains climate-related data files associated with the Katharinentalerhof_Pforzheim event, located at latitude 48.92 and longitude 8.7. It includes twelve unique digital objects, primarily in CSV and DAT formats, with file sizes ranging from 6 to 9240 bytes. The data focuses on land cover change, featuring plant performance metrics and weather observations alongside Noah-MP model outputs. These files serve as identifiers for specific climate measurements and aggregations. Researchers can utilize this dataset to analyze the impacts of varying land cover compositions on local environmental conditions and plant performance in the Kraichgau region.
